description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Computer Networks topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: computer-networks

facts.claim: The OSI model has seven layers

source.quote: The recommendation X.200 describes seven layers, labelled 1 to 7

facts.claim: Physical, data link, network, transport, session, presentation, application

source.quote: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, and Application

facts.claim: Common topologies: ring, bus, mesh and star

source.quote: A wide variety of physical topologies have been used in LANs, including ring, bus, mesh and star

facts.claim: Logical topology can differ from physical

source.quote: the original twisted pair Ethernet using repeater hubs was a logical bus topology carried on a physical star topology

facts.claim: Circuit switching sets up a dedicated channel first

source.quote: two network nodes establish a dedicated communications channel (circuit) through the network

facts.claim: Circuit delay is constant; packet queues add varying delay

source.quote: In circuit switching, the bit delay is constant during a connection

facts.claim: Detection with parity, checksums or CRC

source.quote: Error detection is most commonly realized using a suitable hash function (or specifically, a checksum, cyclic redundancy check

facts.claim: Check bits derived from the data are added

source.quote: attaches a fixed number of check bits (or parity data), which are derived from the data bits

facts.claim: Each packet gets a sequence number; ACKs return it

source.quote: Each packet receives a sequence number, and the ACKs send back that number

facts.claim: The receiver acknowledges with an ACK

source.quote: it sends an acknowledgment signal, or ACK, back to the sender

facts.claim: Slotted ALOHA doubles throughput to about 36.8%

source.quote: improving throughput to 36.8%

facts.claim: CSMA: listen before sending

source.quote: a listen before send random-access protocol

facts.claim: Ethernet sends data in frames

source.quote: Systems communicating over Ethernet divide a stream of data into shorter pieces called frames

facts.claim: Each adapter has a unique 48-bit MAC address

source.quote: each adapter comes programmed with a globally unique 48-bit MAC address

facts.claim: IPv4 addresses are 32 bits

source.quote: IPv4 uses a 32-bit address space which provides 4,294,967,296 (232) unique addresses

facts.claim: Written in dotted-decimal notation

source.quote: the quad-dotted IP address in the illustration (172.16.254.1) represents the 32-bit decimal number 2886794753

facts.claim: Distance-vector routing uses Bellman–Ford

source.quote: Distance-vector routing protocols use the Bellman–Ford algorithm to calculate the best route

facts.claim: Distance measured in hops; neighbours exchange tables

source.quote: Distance-vector routing protocols measure the distance by the number of routers a packet has to pass; one router counts as one hop

facts.claim: TCP is connection-oriented with a three-way handshake

source.quote: they do this through a three-way handshake procedure

facts.claim: Reliable, ordered, error-checked delivery

source.quote: providing reliable, ordered, and error-checked delivery of a stream of octets

facts.claim: UDP is connectionless

source.quote: UDP is a connectionless protocol

facts.claim: No guarantee of delivery, ordering or duplicate protection

source.quote: there is no guarantee of delivery, ordering, or duplicate protection

facts.claim: DNS translates domain names to IP addresses

source.quote: it translates readily memorized domain names to the numerical IP addresses

facts.claim: A hierarchical, distributed system

source.quote: The Domain Name System (DNS) is a hierarchical and distributed name service
